challenges.name: fix-busiest-window-off-by-one
challenges.title: Fix the busiest-window finder
challenges.description: The staffing planner books extra pickers for the busiest k days in a row of each scanner's log, and best_window() finds that window. It has off-by-one bugs: the report for SCN-07 says Thu-Sat was the busiest 3 days although Fri-Sun had more scans, a whole-week window (k == n) is rejected as "no window", and when two windows have the same total the later one wins instead of the earliest. Fix best_window so it checks every window [start, start + k) that fits, returns the earliest busiest one, accepts k == n, returns n when no window fits (k == 0 or k > n), and never reads outside the array. The test runner reads "n k" and n daily counts and prints the window and its total.

tests.name: Weekly report: the busiest 3-day window is the last one (Fri-Sun)
k = 1 picks the single busiest day, which is the last day
k == n: the whole week is one valid window
Ties: the earliest of two equal windows wins
k > n: a 3-day window does not fit in 2 days
10-day log: the busiest 4-day window is in the middle
